# appgatesdp_trusted_certificate (Resource)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the object.
- `pem` (String) A certificate in PEM format.

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.
- `tags` (List of String) Array of tags.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Create date.
- `details` (Attributes) X509 certificate details. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--details))
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the entity is protected from manual updates and deletes. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `updated` (String) Last update date.

<a id="nestedatt--details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `details`

Read-Only:

- `certificate` (String) Base64 encoded binary of the certificate. Either DER or PEM formatted depending on the request.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA256 fingerprint of the certificate.
- `issuer` (String) The issuer name of the certificate.
- `serial` (String) X.509 certificate serial number.
- `subject` (String) The subject name of the certificate.
- `subject_public_key` (String) Base64 encoded public key of the certificate.
- `valid_from` (String) Since when the certificate is valid from.
- `valid_to` (String) Until when the certificate is valid.
- `version` (Number) X.509 certificate version.
